title.narrative: Enhanced strategic positioning of UNESCO in the RCP (Africa) & regional entities

description.narrative: The activity will reinforce UNESCO’s positioning in its role as co-chair of OIBC-3 "Innovation, Digitalization, Youth and Transforming Education" and membership of OIBC-1, 2,4,5 and 6 (concerned with data, economic transformation, climate, peace and sub-regional initiatives). It will facilitate UNESCO participation in the various RCP meetings and joint activities, ensuring UNESCO’s substantive engagement and collaboration with other UN agencies and regional partners towards the global and regional development agendas. Regarding the African Union, PAX/AFR will ensure UNESCO participation in the AU Summits, and some strategic collaboration platforms to position UNESCO, have a shared calendar of events, need our coordinated effort such as the AU Specialized Technical Committees (STCs), AU Summit (Theme of the year on education), The annual Africa Regional Forum on Sustainable Development (ARFSD) and its Science and Technology Forum (STI forum) among others.
